name: style-lt-img-onerror
_comment: CANONICAL list of hero-SVG cases shared by the pkgsite leaf (landing.lua svg_problem; tools/formats/landing-filter.test.mjs runs every case through the real filter) and the dataimago R package (.check_svg_markup), whose tests vendor a copy of this file. Edit here first, then re-vendor. Only rules both sides share belong in it; R-only rules (durations, transitions over 300 ms, animation-play-state) stay out.

name: brand-fallback-inlined
svg:
<svg class="di-hero-fallback" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 800" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" focusable="false">
<style>
.di-hero-fallback { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.di-hero-fallback .axis { stroke: var(--color-border-moderate, #8a8a85); stroke-width: 2; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; }
.di-hero-fallback .grid { stroke: var(--color-border-subtle, #c9c9c4); stroke-width: 1; fill: none; }
.di-hero-fallback .curve { fill: none; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }
.di-hero-fallback .c1 { stroke: var(--color-interactive-primary, #1d3b2f); }
.di-hero-fallback .c2 { stroke: var(--color-dataviz-categorical-1, #0072b2); }
.di-hero-fallback .c3 { stroke: var(--color-dataviz-categorical-2, #d55e00); }
.di-hero-fallback .c4 { stroke: var(--color-dataviz-categorical-3, #009e73); }
.di-hero-fallback .c5 { stroke: var(--color-dataviz-categorical-5, #0072b2); }
.di-hero-fallback .c6 { stroke: var(--color-interactive-accent, #b45f06); }
.di-hero-fallback .c7 { stroke: var(--color-content-secondary, #5b5b57); stroke-width: 3; }
.di-hero-fallback .dot { stroke: none; }
.di-hero-fallback .d1 { fill: var(--color-interactive-primary, #1d3b2f); }
.di-hero-fallback .d3 { fill: var(--color-dataviz-categorical-2, #d55e00); }
.di-hero-fallback .d5 { fill: var(--color-dataviz-categorical-5, #0072b2); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .di-hero-fallback .curve {
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 1;
    animation-name: di-hero-draw;
    animation-duration: 2400ms;
    animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
    animation-iteration-count: 3;
    animation-fill-mode: both;
  }
  .di-hero-fallback .c2 { animation-delay: 120ms; }
  .di-hero-fallback .c3 { animation-delay: 240ms; }
  .di-hero-fallback .c4 { animation-delay: 360ms; }
  .di-hero-fallback .c5 { animation-delay: 480ms; }
  .di-hero-fallback .c6 { animation-delay: 600ms; }
  .di-hero-fallback .c7 { animation-delay: 720ms; }
  @keyframes di-hero-draw {
    from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; }
    to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
  }
}
</style>
